description: This file defines the Approval model class for customer approval management within the Opencart e-commerce framework. It provides methods to add and delete customer approval records in the database.

classes.name: Approval
classes.description: A model class for handling customer approval records in the Opencart system.

methods.name: addApproval
methods.description: Creates a new customer approval record in the database with specified customer ID and type.

methods.name: deleteApprovals
methods.description: Deletes existing approval records for a specified customer ID.
